summary.text: Pat Rhudy is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 18 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican incumbent Tyler Smith.
She was also the Democratic nominee for the seat in 2018, 2020 and 2022.

paragraphs.text: Pat Rhudy advanced from the Democratic primary for Georgia House of Representatives District 18 in 2018, 2020 and 2022.
She lost the 2018 general election to incumbent Kevin Cooke, and lost the 2020 and 2022 general elections to Tyler Smith.
She advanced from the Democratic primary again on May 19, 2026.
